overrideNotes.@adjudicate/core: Force a SINGLE @adjudicate/core version (1.9.0) across the workspace. The published @adjudicate/* deps pin core to EXACTLY 1.5.0; the SDD claims-runtime (1.6.0) + W6 valueBinding/falsifier/renderableCanonical (1.7.0) + Track-A egress-brand kernel (1.8.0) + BKL-069 IntentActor.role carrier (1.9.0) are purely additive (1.9.0 ⊇ 1.5.0 — no existing export changed/removed; `role` is an optional field on IntentActor, canonical-drop-safe so intentHash is unaffected, proven by golden vectors v12/v13), so this override safely coerces those transitive 1.5.0 pins up. @claustrum/core (0.6.0 primary on dev + 0.4.0 still transitive) peer-deps @adjudicate/core ^1.8.0, satisfied by 1.9.0 as a single shared instance (no duplicate core). Published on npm (registry.npmjs.org/@adjudicate/core/-/core-1.9.0.tgz). Remove/relax only if the @adjudicate/* deps move to a compatible RANGE.

ignoreCveNotes.CVE-2026-35042: fast-jwt <=6.1.0 GHSA-hm7r-c7qw-ghp6 — accepts unknown `crit` header extensions (RFC 7515 violation). No upstream patch released yet. Mitigation: we never set or trust `crit` headers in our JWT flow (Twilio Verify OTP only). Re-check when nearform/fast-jwt ships a fix.
ignoreCveNotes.CVE-2026-44680: @mikro-orm/knex SQL injection (GHSA-cfw5-68c4-ffqp, patched >=6.6.14) — same situation + mitigation as the @mikro-orm/core advisories below: pulled exclusively by @medusajs/deps, which pins the MikroORM 6.4.x line; forcing 6.6.x crashes Medusa's service bootstrap (the 6.4→6.6 EventManager subscribers Array->Set change). Mitigation: nothing in this repo runs user-controlled queries through MikroORM — Medusa is the only consumer and all its query paths are parameterized. FE-D08 (2026-07-16) re-attempted the 6.6.14 override: `pnpm install`, apps/commerce's vitest suite, and `medusa build` all passed clean, but none of those exercise the live DI-container service-bootstrap path where the documented crash occurs, and reaching that needs a running `medusa start`/`develop` (forbidden by this repo's CLAUDE.md — no starting dev servers to verify changes). Reverted rather than ship an unverified risk. Remove when Medusa upgrades MikroORM, or when someone can verify the live-boot path.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9: Documentation only — not enforced (pnpm ignoreCves only matches CVE-* IDs). vite <=6.4.1 path traversal in optimized deps .map handling. Pulled by @medusajs/framework which has a hard peer dep on `vite ^5.4.21`, so we cannot override to 6.4.2+ without breaking medusa's admin-vite-plugin. Dev-server-only vuln, not exploitable in production builds. Stays as a moderate in audit output (below the --audit-level=high CI threshold). Remove when medusa upgrades to vite v6+.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-gwhv-j974-6fxm: Documentation only — not enforced (pnpm ignoreCves only matches CVE-* IDs). @mikro-orm/core SQL injection. Pulled exclusively by @medusajs/deps@2.13.5 which pins @mikro-orm/core to 6.4.16. Cannot override to a patched 6.6.x line because @medusajs/utils was built against MikroORM 6.4's EventManager (subscribers is an Array with .some()); 6.6+ switched subscribers to a Set, so registerInternalServiceEventSubscriber crashes on the first service bootstrap. Mitigation: nothing in this repo executes user-controlled queries through MikroORM — Medusa is the only consumer and all its query paths are parameterized. Re-check when Medusa upgrades to MikroORM 6.6+ or 7.x.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-qpfv-44f3-qqx6: Documentation only — same situation and mitigation as GHSA-gwhv-j974-6fxm. Second SQL injection advisory against the same @mikro-orm/core 6.4.x line pulled via @medusajs/deps@2.13.5. Paired tracking — remove both together when Medusa bumps MikroORM.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr: esbuild <0.28.1 — Deno binary-integrity verification bypass, N/A to this Node repo (we never run the esbuild Deno binary). Re-introduced deliberately by pinning esbuild to ^0.25.0: esbuild 0.28 lowers destructuring more strictly and crashes Medusa's admin-vite-plugin dep optimizer against the @react-aria/@ariakit ESM (admin /app/login spins forever), so 0.28 is not usable here. 0.25.x already fixes the only OTHER esbuild advisory (GHSA-67mh dev-server CORS). Remove when medusa upgrades vite to v6+ and esbuild 0.28 becomes usable.
ignoreCveNotes.GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff: vite `server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows alternate paths. The vitest + qa-viewer instances (vite v7) ARE fixed via the `vite@7: 7.3.5` override above. The ONLY remaining instance is `@medusajs/framework>vite` (v5.x), which has no patched release in the 5.x line (patched is >=6.4.3) and cannot be overridden because medusa hard-pins `vite ^5.4.21` (forcing v6 breaks medusa's admin-vite-plugin — see the GHSA-4w7w note). Dev-server-only vuln (we run `vitest run` + production builds, never a long-lived vite dev server) and Windows-only; not exploitable here. Remove when medusa upgrades to vite v6+.
